properties.sourceGeometry: One original complete valid explicitly closed red vector ring; no repair, joining, rounding, snapping, buffering, clipping or simplification applied to export.
properties.manualIdentityQualification: The page title and interior Hiboun label uniquely identify the complete target ring. Its northern black governorate boundary separately labels Baghdadi and Moknine; its eastern black edge follows the coast. The southern red divider separates Zahra and Rmel, and the western red divider separates Chiba. Only the full target ring376 is exported; the adjacent Rmel ring381 reaches the viewport and is not substituted or joined. Decree annex1 page20 first row is Hiboun to Hiboun, continuing the Mahdia parent cell from page19.
